summary: Open APIs cover three of the needed ingredients separately: PBDB for fossil records per clade, TimeTree for divergence times, Catalogue of Life/Open Tree for living species counts. No ready table of per-clade evolutionary distinctiveness vs species count vs fossil richness exists; it would need assembly across clades with fossil records.
next_step: Choose ~20 clades (include Monotremata, Rhynchocephalia, Dipnoi, Ginkgoales plus species-rich controls); compute isolation from a dated tree, species counts from CoL, fossil richness from PBDB; pre-register a birth-death null.
obstacles_confirmed: Fossil preservation bias for small/soft-bodied/tropical taxa
Low speciation rates can give species-poor clades without major extinction
Circularity if aberrance defined by distinctness
